values.binNote: No bin row stores 82.5/132/181.5 or 0.66 directly; the wiki's heal numbers are the wiki-computed product of ZaahenR.EndDamage x ZaahenR.HealPercent (250*0.33=82.5 etc.) and ZaahenR.BonusADDamageRatio x ZaahenR.HealPercent (2*0.33=0.66), matching the notes' claim that the heal equals 33% of the damage numbers rather than an independent bin calculation.

mechanics.claim: Zaahen gains crowd control immunity during the cast time, then dashes into the air with displacement immunity to the target location.
mechanics.quote: gains {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} over the cast time, then {{tip|dash|launches}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} into the air to the target location

mechanics.claim: He slams the ground after a 0.6-second delay following the dash, dealing damage to nearby enemies at that point (not on cast).
mechanics.quote: slams his glaive down after a {{fd|0.6}}-second delay, unleashing a shockwave that deals {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: Zaahen heals for each champion hit by the shockwave, separate from the enemy-facing damage.
The heal is calculated from the damage numbers directly, not the damage actually dealt (e.g. reduced by resistances).
mechanics.quote: The healing per champion is equal to 33% of the damage numbers, '''not''' the damage dealt.

mechanics.claim: Zaahen is unable to act and gains 50% damage reduction from the start of the cast time, retained through the delay and briefly after the slam.
mechanics.quote: '''Zaahen''' is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} and gains 50% [[damage reduction]] from the start of the cast time

mechanics.claim: A spell shield will block the damage of Grim Deliverance but not the heal.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the damage but not the heal.
